name: browser-use
headline: personal assistant for productivity
short_description: Panel-based personal assistant with a plugin architecture for productivity workflows. AI agents share a workspace of notes, lists and other panels with the user. Supports Claude Code, Codex, and pi CLI agents with text and voice interfaces. Extend with custom plugins or use built-in plugins exported as skills with CLIs.
author: kcosr

sections.overview:
Assistant is a personal AI workspace that enables multiple CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Pi) to collaborate on shared panels for notes, lists, and diff reviews. The system features a plugin architecture allowing custom workflows and skills that can be exported for use with compatible agents. Users interact through text chat and voice input/output, with persistent session management via JSONL event logs. Built-in plugins handle common productivity tasks, while custom plugins extend functionality for specific workflows. The platform supports scheduled sessions for cron-driven runs and tool integration via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Multi-agent note-taking and list collaboration within a shared workspace
Exporting plugins as reusable skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi agents
Voice-controlled task management with TTS output from OpenAI or ElevenLabs
Automated workflow scheduling via cron-driven CLI agent sessions
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/kcosr/assistant`
sections.usage:
```
Act as my personal assistant. Create a new workspace for [COMPANY] in [INDUSTRY]. Set up panels for notes, tasks, and contacts. Use the following data to populate the workspace: [DATA]. Ensure the workspace is accessible via both text and voice interfaces.
```
Copy

```
# Workspace Setup for GreenTech Solutions
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
